caption: The drawing depicts two main objects on a plain, light-colored background. On the left side, there is a side view of a table with a rectangular top, a single central support column, and three curved legs extending outward at the base, ending in small feet. The table is rendered in a monochromatic style, using fine black lines and subtle shading. Directly to the right of the table, there is a top view of a rectangular chessboard, also outlined in black. The chessboard consists of an 8x8 grid of alternating dark and light squares, and is set within a double-lined rectangular border. The drawing's composition is centered horizontally, with both objects separate and not overlapping, leaving a significant amount of empty space, and the artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Checkerboard Table
